sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, and account details when you sign up or use our services.
We also automatically collect certain technical information, including:
list: Browser type, device type, and operating system
Usage data such as pages visited, actions taken, and timestamps

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use the information we collect to operate, maintain, and improve our services, including to:
list: Provide customer support and respond to inquiries
Monitor and prevent fraud, abuse, or security incidents
Analyze usage trends to improve platform performance
Communicate updates, security alerts, and administrative messages

sections.title: 3. How We Share Information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with third parties only in the following circumstances:
list: With service providers who help us operate our platform (e.g. hosting, analytics, payment processing)
When required by law, legal process, or governmental request
To protect the rights, property, or safety of our users or the public
In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets

sections.title: 4. Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide our services. We may retain certain data longer where required for legal, security, or legitimate business purposes.

sections.title: 5. Data Security
paragraphs: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect your information from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 6. Cookies & Tracking
paragraphs: We use cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember preferences, and understand how our platform is used. You can control cookie settings through your browser, though disabling cookies may affect platform functionality.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights & Choices
paragraphs: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or export your personal information. You can manage most account information directly in your account settings, or contact us to make a request.

sections.title: 8. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Our services are not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can remove it.

sections.title: 9. International Data Transfers
paragraphs: Your information may be processed and stored in countries other than your own. By using our services, you consent to the transfer of your information to these locations, which may have different data protection laws.

sections.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
